goal: A website for Sharma Tailors, Nashik: what we stitch, the price list, our number 98220 12345, where the shop is, and a WhatsApp button to send us a photo of the design.
why: the fourth instance, in a local non-tech owner's words (founder, 2026-09-28: 'a very, very native, very, very local, trivial user'); the person judges by what she sees in ten seconds and never scrolls up

outcomes.expect: from opening the app to the shop's Root chat in three clicks or fewer, with no screen she has to read

verify.check: rows from open to Root chat <= 3 clicks

outcomes.expect: every question the app puts to her is one plain line with a button

verify.check: each ask's text under 160 characters, no word from the never-list

outcomes.expect: 98220 12345 on every page, the price list as she typed it, the shop's name spelled her way

verify.check: 98220 12345 on every page; 'Sharma Tailors' in the title

outcomes.expect: the site goes live only after her stamp, and she is told it is live with one button to see it

verify.check: a publish ask before Live site v1; a live turn with a link after

outcomes.expect: every message of hers gets a reply or a working line within 60 s

verify.check: no row waits over 60 s without a turn or a working line

outcomes.expect: after she sends, her words and the reply are in view without scrolling

verify.check: the last turn is on screen after Send

variances.say: Blouse stitching 350, saree fall 80, kurta 450, alteration 100. Put the price list.
variances.expect: a Prices page or section with those four lines, exactly

verify.check: the four prices on one page

variances.say: People should send the design photo on WhatsApp.
variances.expect: the app asks in plain words whether a WhatsApp link to 98220 12345 goes on the site; after her stamp, a wa.me link on every page

variances.say: It is Sharma Tailors, not Sharma Tailor.

variances.do: close the app for five minutes while the line runs; reopen
variances.expect: the chat shows what happened while she was away, newest in view

verify.check: the newest turn in view on reopen

variances.do: click Map, then the switch, by mistake; click Chat
variances.expect: the chat says Stopped by you and Started by you when she flips it back; nothing lost
